lines_zh: 《守望 · 永昌》
Vampire Survivors-like 割草生存 Roguelite
主题：守 · 望 / 永昌堡与明代抗倭记忆
2026 OSGJ 开源游戏开发大赛参赛作品
新增正俯视建筑屋顶与方向河岸图：OpenAI ImageGen 生成原图，Pillow 通过 pixel-art/overhead_buildings/build.py 及 full_composed_atlas/build.py 确定性裁切；箭塔平台中央留给实时瞄准连弩。原创非代码资产 CC BY 4.0。
已完成：序章 1386 宁村所、正篇 1559 永昌堡割草生存、双堡图鉴、灯火风险收益、龙鳞清屏、剧情字幕（输出授权未核实的 MOSS 语音已下架）、铺满屏幕的局内军市、CharacterForge 佣兵与骑兵、RTS 式流场寻路、外围奇遇点与运行时随机配装
玩法：16 分钟单局、鼠标瞄准、长按左键攻击、六兵器进化、升级三选一、每 120 秒军市、最多 3 名佣兵、五色龙鳞与 Boss；操作 W/A/S/D 移动，Space 冲刺，Esc 暂停
历史边界：汤和只做 1386 序章主角；1559 正篇主角为虚构守灯乡勇王陆/阿六
策划、程序、像素美术与整合：xingwangzhe
lines_en: WATCH · YONGCHANG
A Vampire Survivors-like survival roguelite
Theme: Guard · Gaze / Yongchang Fort and Ming-era coastal defense
A 2026 OSGJ open-source game development entry

New top-down roof and directional riverbank art: source sheets generated with OpenAI ImageGen and deterministically cut by pixel-art/overhead_buildings/build.py and full_composed_atlas/build.py; tower platforms reserve the center for the live-aiming crossbow. Original non-code art is CC BY 4.0.

Done: the 1386 Ningcun prologue, the 1559 Yongchang survival run, the two-forts codex, lantern risk/reward, dragon-scale clears, narrative subtitles (MOSS voice removed because output rights were unverified), a full-screen in-run market, CharacterForge retinue and cavalry, RTS-style flow-field navigation, outer-ring encounters, and runtime-random loadouts

Gameplay: a 16-minute run with mouse aiming and hold-to-attack, six evolving weapons, one-of-three upgrades, a market every 120 seconds, up to three retinue units, five-colour dragon scales, and a boss; W/A/S/D moves, Space dashes, and Esc pauses
Historical boundary: Tang He is the prologue protagonist only in 1386; the 1559 protagonist is the fictional lamp-watch militia Wang Lu / A-Liu
Design, code, pixel art, and integration: xingwangzhe

sections.title_zh: 骑兵、RTS 寻路与运行时配装
lines_zh: 骑兵图集中的每一帧都是完整骑手与坐骑组合，不拆分马匹、骑手或身体部件。
完整人物分类图集区分端正、整洁的明军友方，与衣甲破损、粗粝凶狠的倭寇敌兵；每行包含对应兵种的八帧整人动作。
角色图集固定使用兵种分类造型。RuntimeLoadout 仍校验阵营合法配装并抽取战斗数据，但随机装备不会改变图集中的外观。
骑兵行每格均保留完整坐骑与骑手；当前攻击动作复用完整骑乘行，避免攻击时变为步兵，尚无独立骑乘攻击姿势。
战斗不从装备配方拼接人物，也不加载旧 144 组变体图集；不拆分身体、武器或马匹图层。
战斗使用共享 BFS 流场、拥挤分离与卡住恢复，并对原生/Web 分别限频刷新导航缓存；骑兵近战/远程、重装步兵、远程与支援单位共用同一套避障与推进。
lines_en: Each cavalry atlas frame shows a complete rider and mount. Riders, horses, and body parts are not assembled as separate layers.
Complete-character category atlases distinguish upright, orderly Ming allies from rough, battered, hostile-looking Wokou enemies. Each unit row contains eight full-character motion frames.
RuntimeLoadout still validates faction-legal gear and samples combat data, but random equipment does not alter the fixed category-row appearance.

Every cavalry frame keeps the complete horse and rider. Cavalry currently reuses its complete mounted row during attacks to avoid switching into an infantry body; dedicated mounted attack poses are not included.
Combat does not assemble characters from equipment recipes or load the retired 144-variant atlas. Bodies, weapons, and horses are never split into runtime layers.

Combat shares a BFS flow field, crowd separation, and stuck recovery, with separate native/Web navigation refresh intervals. Mounted melee/ranged, heavy infantry, ranged, and support units use the same obstacle avoidance and advance rules.

lines_zh: 主菜单：↑↓ 选择，Enter 确认，Esc 关闭设置面板。
战斗：鼠标位置控制攻击方向和角色朝向；长按点击持续攻击，单点会缓冲一次；按 X 开关自动攻击。
军市：每 120 秒在升级之后开市；按 1/2/3 购买兵器、装备或佣兵，R 重掷，Enter 继续。
精灵朝向：水平移动会镜像左右；攻击时优先面向鼠标，避免反向位移。
设置项：BGM/音效、全屏、帧率上限、垂直同步、语言与渲染后端；变更即时写入配置。
自动存档：菜单、设置变化、开局、退出与每 20 秒写入 user://savegame.json。
渲染后端切换后不能热生效；设置页会提示“重启游戏以应用渲染变更”，并提供“立即重启”。
默认渲染模式为自动：支持 Vulkan 时优先 Vulkan，检测不到时回退 OpenGL。
Linux/macOS 使用 game/launch.sh，Windows 使用 game/launch.bat；启动器读取 ASCII 渲染镜像并选择正确的 Godot 启动参数。
lines_en: Menu: ↑↓ to select, Enter to confirm, Esc to close the settings panel.
Combat: the mouse sets attack and character direction; hold-click for continuous fire, tap for one buffered strike, and press X to toggle auto attack.
The market opens every 120 seconds after upgrades; press 1/2/3 for weapons, gear, or retinue, R to reroll, and Enter to continue.
Sprite facing: horizontal movement mirrors left/right; attacks face the mouse so reverse movement never shows the wrong side.
Settings: music/SFX, fullscreen, frame limit, VSync, language, and renderer; changes are saved immediately.
Autosave: menu, settings changes, run start, quit, and every 20 seconds to user://savegame.json.
Renderer changes are not hot-swapped; the settings panel says 'Restart the game to apply the renderer change' and offers 'Restart now'.
The default renderer mode is Auto: Vulkan when supported, otherwise OpenGL.
Launch with game/launch.sh on Linux/macOS or game/launch.bat on Windows; the launcher reads the ASCII renderer mirror and passes the matching Godot flags.

lines_zh: 验收基线：1280×720、可缩放窗口、默认 60 FPS、VSync 开启。
Vulkan 启动参数：--rendering-method forward_plus --rendering-driver vulkan。
OpenGL 启动参数：--rendering-method gl_compatibility --rendering-driver opengl3。
自动检测：Linux 读取 vulkaninfo --summary；Windows 检查 System32/SysWOW64 的 vulkan-1.dll；发现 Vulkan 时默认 Vulkan。
安全回退：检测不到 Vulkan 时默认 OpenGL；project.godot 仍保留 GL Compatibility 作为兜底。
Web 版当前使用浏览器提供的 WebGL 2.0 / OpenGL ES 3.0 Compatibility 渲染。
渲染镜像：Windows 写入 %APPDATA%\WatchYongchang\renderer.cfg；Linux/macOS 写入对应的用户配置目录，避免中文项目名影响批处理。
渲染后端只能在进程启动时选择；设置变更写入 user://settings.cfg，重启后由启动参数应用。
主菜单夜景的分层绘制、粒子与纹理滚动会同时受 GPU 后端与帧率设置影响。
lines_en: Acceptance baseline: 1280×720, resizable window, 60 FPS by default, VSync on.
Vulkan flags: --rendering-method forward_plus --rendering-driver vulkan.
OpenGL flags: --rendering-method gl_compatibility --rendering-driver opengl3.
Detection: Linux reads vulkaninfo --summary; Windows checks vulkan-1.dll in System32/SysWOW64; Vulkan is the default when found.
Safe fallback: OpenGL when Vulkan is unavailable; project.godot keeps GL Compatibility as the final fallback.
The web build currently renders through the browser's WebGL 2.0 / OpenGL ES 3.0 Compatibility backend.
Renderer mirror: Windows writes %APPDATA%\WatchYongchang\renderer.cfg; Linux/macOS use their user config directories so the Chinese project name cannot break batch parsing.
Renderers are selected at process start; the setting is written to user://settings.cfg and applied by the next launch.
Layered drawing, particles, and texture scrolling in the menu nightscape all depend on the GPU backend and frame limit.

lines_zh: 主菜单背景为项目原创动态像素夜景，不再使用简单几何剪影。
母版 640×360、32 色，2× 最近邻导出为 1280×720，保持硬像素边缘。
分层：远景城防与月、循环云层、海浪、渔船、烽火、星点、月光碎影、灯火呼吸与火星。
动画：云层慢速漂移，海浪快速横移并上下起伏，渔船浮动，烽火 9 fps 循环。
生成：skills/pixel-art-studio/ 与 pixel-art/menu_backdrop/build.py；修改后重跑脚本，不手改导出 PNG。
运行时：game/scripts/ui/menu_backdrop.gd；主菜单、关于页与占位开局页共用。
lines_en: The menu background is an original animated pixel nightscape, not a simple geometric silhouette.
A 640×360, 32-color master is exported at 2× nearest-neighbor to 1280×720 for crisp pixel edges.
Layers: distant fort and moon, looping clouds, waves, fishing boats, beacon fire, stars, moon shimmer, breathing lanterns, and embers.
Motion: clouds drift slowly, waves scroll and bob, boats float, and the beacon cycles at 9 fps.
Generated with skills/pixel-art-studio/ and pixel-art/menu_backdrop/build.py; rerun the script instead of editing exported PNGs.
Runtime composition lives in game/scripts/ui/menu_backdrop.gd and is shared by the menu, about page, and placeholder run screen.

sections.title_zh: 剧情语音授权核查与字幕回退
sections.title_en: Narrative Voice Rights Review & Subtitle Fallback
lines_zh: 2026-11-24 核查 OpenMOSS 官方仓库、LICENSE 与 Hugging Face 模型卡：代码和模型产物标注 Apache-2.0，但没有找到明确授权生成语音录音输出的条款。
为避免把代码/模型许可误当作音频输出许可，原先生成的 9 条中文 + 9 条英文 OGG 已全部从成品和仓库运行时目录移除；模型权重从未入包。
剧情不静默跳过：VoiceLinePlayer 按字幕文本以约 4.35 音节/秒计算展示时长，保留完整中英字幕、角色、史实/制度/民俗/演绎分类和 source_ref。
game/data/voice_lines.json 显式设置 audio_enabled=false、distribution=subtitles_only；生成器与模型权重均不随仓库分发。
lines_en: On 2026-11-24 the official OpenMOSS repository, LICENSE, and Hugging Face model cards were reviewed: code and model artifacts are marked Apache-2.0, but no explicit grant for generated voice recordings was found.

To avoid treating a code/model license as an audio-output grant, all 18 former OGG files (nine Chinese and nine English lines) were removed from the runtime and repository; model weights were never shipped.

Narrative is not silently skipped: VoiceLinePlayer times subtitles from the text at roughly 4.35 syllables per second and preserves bilingual subtitles, speakers, source categories, and source_ref metadata.
game/data/voice_lines.json explicitly sets audio_enabled=false and distribution=subtitles_only; the generator and model weights are not distributed.

完整人物动作分类图：主角、友军、敌军、骑兵与攻击姿势按整格帧生成并接入 `game/assets/units/full_sheets/`。每格保持整个人物；骑兵同格绘出骑手和坐骑；攻击格包含人物及手持武器。王陆六张卡仍是同一人物的阵位，现使用六张装备姿态各异的完整人物格。输入、格位、尺寸和校验摘要见 `pixel-art/full_composed_atlas/clean/manifest.json`。

友军分类图包含义师枪兵、藤牌乡兵、义师弓手与旗手四行完整人物帧；其他佣兵角色读取对应完整分类行。阵营与人物叙事配置保留在角色 JSON 中。

Code: AGPL-3.0-or-later; full text in the repository-root LICENSE and scope in NOTICE.

Original non-code assets: CC BY 4.0; specifically identified original BGM masters may also be offered under CC0 1.0, with the prior dedication retained. The shipped menu cue is CC BY 4.0 and the about cue is CC BY 3.0. See NOTICE for the code/asset scope.
Animated pixel nightscape, menu UI, and about-page layout: project originals; exported nightscape assets are CC BY 4.0, while the generator code is AGPL-3.0-or-later.

Ming-era coastal-defense terrain, architecture, props, and animated map tiles use lossless PNG category atlases generated by pixel-art/full_composed_atlas/build.py; original non-code art is CC BY 4.0.
Animated map props: four 4-frame loops for red lanterns, fishing boats, Ming banners, and beacon fire at 32×32 per frame, generated by pixel-art/yongchang_tiles/build.py, released under CC BY 4.0.

Tile art direction: a Ming-era coastal fort in southern Zhejiang; grey stone walls, dark roof tiles, whitewashed walls, red-lacquer gates, stepped gables, water gates, beacon fires, chevaux-de-frise, fishing boats, reed flats, and stone guardians.
